preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in S) and all(c.islower() for c in T)
preconditions.description: Both strings S and T consist only of lowercase English letters.
Constraints on N (length of S), M (length of T), and K (total transformation cost) are satisfied.
The lengths of S and T match the given integers N and M.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum number of occurrences of S as a substring in T' after transformations, where T' is derived from T with total transformation cost ≤ K.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i <= M - N for i in [j for j in range(M - N + 1) if S == T'[j:j+N]])
postconditions.description: For every occurrence of S in T', the substring T'[i:i+N] equals S for some valid starting index i in T'.

postconditions.expression: sum(min(abs(ord(c1) - ord(c2)), 26 - abs(ord(c1) - ord(c2))) for c1, c2 in zip(T, T')) <= K
postconditions.description: The total transformation cost from T to T' does not exceed K, where cost is the minimal cyclic distance between characters.

postconditions.expression: not any(int(stdout) < count for count in [sum(1 for i in range(M - N + 1) if S == T_candidate[i:i+N]) for T_candidate in possible_T_prime(T, K)])
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible count of S as a substring in any T' derived from T with total transformation cost ≤ K, where possible_T_prime(T, K) is the set of all possible T' strings obtainable from T with total cost ≤ K.
